metadata.description: wrap-up ends a Claude Code session on purpose rather than by closing the terminal: it consolidates what the session learned into current-state notes, then cleans up only what the session itself left behind. https://github.com/Miguel-Barroso/claude-wrap-up

plugins.name: wrap-up
plugins.description: End-of-session pass: consolidate memory into current-state notes, then clean up this session's own debris — leftover watchers, schedules, temp files — and report what is still open. A read-only checker does the mechanical part; nothing is deleted that the session did not create.
